newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE ON TOP AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE ON TOP AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: A disciplined bowling and fielding performance by Zimbabwe restricted India to 216 all out in the day/night 50 overs a side match at Centurion Park on Friday.
Sachin Tendulkar's team failed to take advantage of batting first on a good pitch and they fell 20 or 30 runs short of a good score.

Tendulkar added 70 for the fourth wicket with Mohammad Azharuddin, the best stand of the innings, but fell for 41 to a catch in the deep against the occasional off-spin of Zimbabwe captain Alistair Campbell.

When Azharuddin was stumped for 44 off leg spinner Paul Strang, all rounder Ajay Jadeja smashed 36 off 40 balls. But he was sent back and run out at the non-striker's end to check the inpetus of the innings.

Campbell used eight bowlers in an effort to unsettle the Indians and they were suported by an outstanding fielding performance. The last three wickets fell with the total on 216 as India self-destructed at the end.
Both sides are on one point in the triangular series and are fighting to meet South Africa in Wednesday's final. The two teams meet again in Benoni in the final group match on Sunday.
